javascript:(()=>{if(window.__ISLENSKA_SOLVER__){if(window.__ISLENSKA_SOLVER__.version==="5.0.0"){window.__ISLENSKA_SOLVER__.toggle();return}window.__ISLENSKA_SOLVER__.destroy()}if(window.__ISLENSKA_LOADING__)return;const s=document.createElement('script');let t;s.src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/B10xDragon/islenska-solver@v5.0.0/dist/solver.bundle.js?v=5.0.0";const load=()=>{window.__ISLENSKA_LOADING__=true;t=setTimeout(()=>s.onerror(),20000);document.documentElement.appendChild(s)};s.onload=()=>{clearTimeout(t);window.__ISLENSKA_LOADING__=false;if(!window.__ISLENSKA_SOLVER__)s.onerror();else document.getElementById('islenska-load-error')?.remove()};s.onerror=()=>{clearTimeout(t);window.__ISLENSKA_LOADING__=false;s.remove();console.error('Íslenska Solver could not load',s.src);if(document.getElementById('islenska-load-error'))return;const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='islenska-load-error';e.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:16px;right:16px;z-index:2147483647;background:white;color:#173c30;padding:18px;border:2px solid #17644e;border-radius:12px;font:16px system-ui';e.textContent='Íslenska Solver — Could not load solver. ';const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent='Retry';b.style.cssText='min-height:44px;padding:12px';b.onclick=()=>{e.remove();load()};e.appendChild(b);document.documentElement.appendChild(e)};load()})()
